sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 35 mK; optical: 1/2.8in progressive scan CMOS
features: thermal and optical bi-spectrum MINI positioning system (PTZ), pan 360 continuous / tilt -90 to +90
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 32x optical zoom (4.8-153 mm)
temperature measurement -20 to 550 C, accuracy max (+/-2 C, +/-2%)
fire detection algorithm (dynamic fire and smoke, up to 10 fire and 10 smoke points)
VCA behavior analysis: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
thermal detector: 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, VOx UFPA, NETD <= 35 mK, 8-14 um
optical IR illuminator up to 30 m
picture-in-picture thermal/optical fusion, target coloration, wiper, RS-485
release_notes: The HIKMICRO HM-TD5567T-7 is a thermal and optical bi-spectrum MINI network positioning system (PTZ) with a 640x512 VOx thermal detector, a 4 MP 32x optical zoom channel, on-board temperature measurement (-20 to 550 C) and fire/smoke detection. Aimed at fire-prevention and perimeter scenes such as substations, recycling centers and gas stations. Verified against the official HIKMICRO datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal (Channel 2) and optical (Channel 1) exposed as separate channels.
